result.summary: T010 BLOCKER migration implemented per design src/design/iss0181-gh512-t010-migration.md. Converted 99 unique T010 sites across 5 batches (Batches 1, 2a, 2b, 2c, 2d, 2e, 3, 4, 5) using TestHarness.newUuid() (binary form) and h.newUuidString(alloc); defer alloc.free(s) (string form). 51 sites received retention comments per design §R1 (definition-sentinel), §R2 (platform-admin), or §R3 (creator/identity convention). Baseline regenerated: T010 reduced from 184 to 73. All 73 remaining sites are module-scope constants (comptime, cannot be runtime-converted) or document-identity fixtures matched against substring assertions in the same test — both classes that the design explicitly mandates as RETAIN. zig build exits 0, zig build test exit 0 (lint_test_wiring: 266 file(s) reachable from addTest root), tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exit 0 (Suppressed 114 issue(s) from baseline), tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exit 0 (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR). tools/lint_handoffs.py reports zero new BLOCKER/MAJOR on handoffs/WF03-GH512-20260808/* files. Feature branch feature/WF03-GH512-20260808 pushed to origin (1a9a0d03..00abb9fa, 3 new commits in this session: f97d1f58 batch 5, 00abb9fa baseline regen; batch 4 64d82a93 was pushed earlier).

issues.description: Remaining 73 T010 sites are module-scope `const` declarations or document-identity fixtures matched against substring assertions in the same test body. Per design src/design/iss0181-gh512-t010-migration.md §3 R1-R3, these are RETAIN. Converting them would require rewriting the test to allocate a per-test UUID and re-deriving the substrings from that, which is out of scope for a T010-only migration.
issues.resolution: No change required. Documented in design §3 as a deliberate retention decision.
